title: Workspace request waits and returns the answer automatically
description: Verify the managed Agent discovers a granted target, submits once, remains active, and returns the target answer without a user reminder.

requires.runnerImage: The source session uses the issue #511 pi-chrome image revision
requires.targetWorkspace: A same-owner disposable target with a saved working model/provider selection
requires.turnBudget: One source turn and one target automation turn, each read-only and bounded to ten minutes

steps.expected: The embedded Agent UI is ready and exposes workspace_request_ask and workspace_request_wait through the managed automation MCP server.
The source used one stable idempotency key and the target has exactly one ticket/run for this question.
WORKSPACE_REQUEST_OK is visible in the originating conversation and no second user message was sent.
